title: Fill with Gemini’s web citations arrive cell by cell
summary: Trace AI-generated Sheets cells to web sources. Check the request limit, eligible plans and October rollout dates before relying on availability.
body_markdown:
##


Trace the value, then check it


Google’s[October 28 notice](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2026/10/fill-with-gemini-now-provides-cell-level-citations-for-web-sources-and-supports-larger-requests.html) says values generated with the AI function now carry web sources for each cell in Google Sheets on the web.


For a cell summarising a product specification, inspect whether the cited page supports that value for the intended product version and date. A link makes the origin easier to inspect; its presence does not establish that the value is correct.


For calculations built from generated values, OpenTools’[spreadsheet‑tools guide](https://opentools.ai/resources/best-ai-spreadsheet-tools) recommends a small hand‑checked sample and reconciling a known total. That is general validation guidance, not a test of Gemini’s outputs.
